notes:
# A link copied out of an email keeps its passcode {link}
Mail turns `&` into `&`, and the passcode after it was being dropped — so
Zoom asked for one while the same link clicked in the mail worked.

# The update panel fits the screen {refresh}
A long release made a panel taller than the display, with Install below the
bottom edge and no way to resize it.

# Time zones read the meeting's own date {globe}
A January meeting in New York was labelled with September's offset.

# The window is the new one {sliders}
This build opens the rebuilt window by default. Everything the old one did,
it does.

---

Everything else in this release:

- The recording view no longer keeps the previous meeting's form fields
  alive behind it.
- Settings is rebuilt: General, Recording, Automation, Alerts, Analysis,
  Licence and Advanced, with Save and Revert and per-page defaults.
- Record now on the meeting form: it saves what is on screen, drops the
  schedule so nothing runs twice, and starts the run.
- The window rescues a run the schedule missed, and puts right a launchd
  job whose time has drifted, on the launch after it happens.
- Diagnostics name this Mac's time zone and what launchd was actually told,
  which is what "it ran at the wrong hour" reports have always been missing.
- Notes from a recording open in their own window, with the markdown drawn
  rather than printed.
